dct_title_s: Jitchi tōsoku Kōbe shigai zenzu = : New map of Kobe
dct_alternative_sm: 實地踏測神戸市街全圖 = : New map of Kobe
dct_description_sm: Oriented with north to the right.
Includes 3 insets : Fukin ippanzu; Kōbe Aakashi kan zu; Akashi shigaizu.
Includes 3 insets : 附近一般圖; 神戸明石間圖; 明石市街圖.
Text, pictures and index of streets' names and two maps (Banshū chizu and Himeji-shi zenzu) on verso.
Text, pictures and index of streets' names and two maps (播州地圖 and 姬路市全圖) on verso.
